title: Recraft ores
description: A balanced way of recrafting ore blocks for convenience.
body:
Spend more of your resources for the convenience of not having to go back into the cave/nether again.

![The crafting recipe for a diamond ore block, a diamond block surrounded by stone.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51ddae64b1dd19803d80d33ef3af81c5fcc411f3.png)

**Other recpies are shown in the gallery**

To prevent duping, the recpies are rather expensive but i believe it is fair, especially as you won't need tons of ore blocks in a build.
